clue.text: Gathers a university man fools around

indicators.note: the fools are placed around the graduate, so the one word is cut open to hold the other

parts.note: asses are fools
an MA, a Master of Arts, is a university graduate

explanation.surface: A college man is messing about with some fools.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts MA inside ASSES, straight after its first A.
explanation.definitionFit: To amass is to collect or pile up, so the verb matches gathers.

clue.text: A dividend the high-minded person is opposed to

parts.note: a dividend is a gain or return
ST is the abbreviation for saint, a person of lofty virtue

explanation.surface: A shareholder's payout that the principled person objects to.
explanation.definitionFit: Against is a preposition meaning in opposition to.

clue.text: Nobody settled, that's acknowledged

explanation.surface: No debts were paid, and that is admitted.
explanation.walkthrough: If nobody settled, everyone still owes: split the answer into two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means every debt is outstanding; as one, it means permitted or conceded.

clue.text: Soldiers turning on many a Greek character

indicators.note: turning means the soldiers' word is turned round and read backwards

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, that is, many

explanation.surface: Troops rounding on many a Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: Sigma is the eighteenth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Treatment of cod-steaks offering some protection

indicators.note: treatment means handling or processing, so the letters of cod-steaks are reworked

explanation.surface: Cooking cod steaks gives some protection.
explanation.definitionFit: Stockades are defensive barriers of upright stakes, offering shelter.

clue.text: Craft centre taking in a hundred pound

indicators.note: the centre word takes in the following letters, enclosing them within itself

parts.note: the core is the centre
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling (from Latin libra)

explanation.surface: A craft centre has brought in a hundred pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: A coracle is a small round Welsh boat, a type of watercraft.

clue.text: Keeping company with degenerate artist

parts.note: to rot is to decay or degenerate

explanation.surface: Associating with a decadent painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot was a French landscape painter.

clue.text: Following some who would declare sultan the ruler

indicators.note: some means only part of the following words supplies the letters

explanation.surface: Coming after some people who would proclaim the sultan as ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: Resultant means following as a consequence.

clue.text: Note printed below feature about a certain wine

indicators.note: in a down entry, printed below means the note comes after the rest
the facial feature goes about the letter, enclosing it

parts.note: the chin is a facial feature
TI is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A memo printed below an article about a particular wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feature' suggests a newspaper article; here it is a part of the face.
explanation.definitionFit: Chianti is a red wine from Tuscany.

clue.text: Nearing disunity, colour deeply

indicators.note: disunity means the letters of nearing are broken apart and rearranged

explanation.surface: Close to breaking apart, staining heavily.
explanation.definitionFit: To engrain is to dye fast or work a pigment into the fibre.

clue.text: Brisk instruction, legal or otherwise

indicators.note: otherwise means in another way, so the letters of legal and or are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sharp order, whether lawful or not.
explanation.definitionFit: Allegro is a musical direction to play at a quick, lively tempo.

clue.text: Daring outfit having leather insertion

indicators.note: the outfit has the leather inserted into it, a container instruction
the outfit has the leather inserted into it, a container instruction

parts.note: a rig is an outfit of clothes or equipment
skin is hide, the stuff of leather

explanation.surface: A daring costume with a leather panel set into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Risking means venturing or chancing something, as daring does.

clue.text: Course finding much favour with businessmen?

definitions.text: Course finding much favour with businessmen?

parts.words: Course finding much favour with businessmen?
parts.note: a fresh opening for trade would please businessmen, but the course is the famous racecourse in Suffolk

explanation.walkthrough: Newmarket is a historic horse-racing town and racecourse in Suffolk, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Newmarket is an English racecourse, read cryptically as a fresh trading outlet.

clue.text: Woman left inside by American lawyer

parts.note: in means inside
a DA is a district attorney, a US prosecutor

explanation.surface: A woman abandoned indoors by an American attorney.
explanation.definitionFit: Linda is a female given name.

clue.text: The royal family possibly tour around hundreds

indicators.note: the rearranged tour goes around the numeral, enclosing it
possibly signals the letters of tour may be arranged differently

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, that is, five hundreds

explanation.surface: The royal family might take a tour of hundreds of places.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' turns TOUR into TUOR, and 'around' wraps it round D.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudors were the English ruling house from Henry VII to Elizabeth I.

clue.text: The family tells about 4

indicators.note: the word for tells goes about the numeral, enclosing it

parts.note: relates means tells or narrates
IV is the Roman numeral for four

explanation.surface: The family recounts things concerning clue 4.
explanation.walkthrough: '4' looks like a reference to another clue, but it is just the number four.
explanation.definitionFit: Relatives are kin, the members of one's family.

clue.text: Backing senseless people will result in utter ruin

indicators.note: backing means moving backwards, so the word for senseless is read in reverse

parts.note: mad means senseless
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: Supporting foolish folk will end in total disaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Damnation is eternal condemnation, the utmost ruin of a soul.

clue.text: A scoundrel seen where money's made holding races maybe

indicators.note: the place where coins are struck holds the rearranged letters

parts.note: the mint is where coins are produced

indicators.note: maybe signals the letters of races are arranged another way

explanation.surface: A villain spotted at the Mint with some races going on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges RACES as SCREA, and 'holding' puts it inside MINT.
explanation.definitionFit: A miscreant is a wrongdoer or villain.

clue.text: Thought heels to be impractical individuals

parts.note: an idea is a thought
a ship that heels leans over, that is, lists

explanation.surface: Someone thought heels made people unrealistic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heels' is the nautical verb for leaning, not the shoe parts.
explanation.definitionFit: Idealists pursue perfect visions, often seen as unrealistic dreamers.

clue.text: Tick's on the spot

explanation.surface: The clock's tick right here.
explanation.definitionFit: A tick is a moment; something done on the spot is immediate.

clue.text: Blow up!

parts.note: sounds like an explosion, but a photograph can be blown up to a bigger size

explanation.definitionFit: To blow up a picture is to make it bigger.

clue.text: Judge from a Continental city

explanation.surface: A judge from a city on the Continent.
explanation.definitionFit: A judge is one who tries cases; Trier is an ancient city in western Germany.

clue.text: In it one takes a trainee first

parts.note: taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one
L is a learner, as on British learner-driver plates

explanation.surface: In this one, someone takes on a novice.
explanation.definitionFit: Initial means coming at the beginning, earliest.

clue.text: Go back and find the right exit

parts.note: an egress is a way out

explanation.surface: Retreat and look for the correct way out.
explanation.definitionFit: To regress is to return to an earlier state, to move backwards.

clue.text: Divide the port

explanation.surface: Partition the harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide is to break apart; Split is a port city on the Croatian coast.

clue.text: Go round in pain, walking slowly

indicators.note: in places the word for go round within the word for pain

parts.note: a sting is a sharp pain
to roll is to go round, turning over

explanation.surface: Someone turning over in agony while ambling along.
explanation.definitionFit: Strolling is sauntering, a leisurely pace on foot.

clue.text: Reception room for the arranging of loans

indicators.note: arranging means putting the letters of loans into a new order

explanation.surface: A room where loans are set up.
explanation.definitionFit: A salon is an elegant drawing room for receiving guests.

clue.text: Enabled a man to discover the way to Hell!

parts.note: let means allowed or enabled
he is a man, referred to by the pronoun

explanation.surface: Someone allowed a man to find the road to Hell.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth the Lethe is a river of Hades, the underworld.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lethe, the river of forgetfulness, flows in the classical underworld.

clue.text: The coming of a king to confront enemy

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for king (Latin rex)
a rival is an opponent or enemy

explanation.surface: The arrival of a monarch to face his foe.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrival is the act of reaching a place, its coming.

clue.text: Like time to travel on horseback?

parts.note: as means like
to ride is to travel

explanation.surface: Is it like the time we travelled on horseback?
explanation.definitionFit: Astride means with legs either side, the way a rider sits a horse; the question mark admits it is not quite the same.

clue.text: Subversion of the new senator

indicators.note: new signals a fresh arrangement of the letters of senator

explanation.surface: Subversive activity by the newly elected senator.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason is betrayal of one's country, an act of subversion.

clue.text: A climbing frame for erecting in the garden

definitions.text: A climbing frame for erecting in the garden

parts.words: A climbing frame for erecting in the garden
parts.note: looks like a children's play frame, but the climbers are plants trained up a lattice

explanation.definitionFit: A trellis is a lattice of wood that climbing plants grow up.
